modulation.description: Models modulation between ethics constraints and governance boundaries using bounded structural channels.

cross_surface_alignment.description: Routes and aligns structural flows between ethics and governance surfaces without expressive geometry.

gating.description: Applies governance-layer gating across ethics-governance interaction surfaces.

stabilization.description: Maintains stable interaction geometry during governance-boundary transitions and modulation cycles.

dissipation.description: Models dissipation of interaction intensity within bounded simulation envelopes.

residual_looping.description: Models residual looping behavior within interaction basins formed by ethics-governance modulation.

non_activation_clause.description: This behavioral model is structural-only. It does not activate, simulate, or bind any NDH subsystem, expressive geometry mechanism, holonomy operator, or manifold process.
